name: Honasa Consumer Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2016, Honasa Consumer Limited (HCL) provides beauty and personal care products through its digital platform.[1]
keyPoints: Market Position[1] Honasa is India's largest digital-first beauty and personal care (BPC) company by revenue in FY24. As of CY23, according to Euromonitor, Mamaearth ranks as the third-largest skincare brand in India.[2]

cons: Stock is trading at 7.61 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Earnings include an other income of Rs.82.1 Cr.
